title: reference_form.js DOM choreography (autosave PUT, 409/404 reload, POST fallbacks, stepping, saved indicator) has zero automated test coverage; the form_draft_wiring precedent was not followed
detail: Only three trivial pure functions are tested; the browser wiring (fetch/PUT, 409/404 reload, both POST fallbacks, stepping, saved indicator) has zero coverage, though form_draft.js ships a fake-DOM wiring suite. Test-level-mix gap on AC4's JS arm.
recommended_fix: Add a form_draft_wiring-style fake-DOM test driving the exported _initBrowser seam: PUT success, 409/404 reload, non-ok and network fallbacks, mobile stepping, saved indicator, focus-seconds wiring.

title: shouldStep unit tests are tautological; the real mobile gate (MOBILE_QUERY matchMedia call site) is untested
detail: shouldStep only coerces its argument, so asserting true→true and false→false proves nothing. The real gate (matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)') at line 70, interplay with the 640px CSS breakpoint) is untested.
recommended_fix: Drive initBrowser with a fake matchMedia (matches true/false) and assert only the current question is visible, stepping occurs below 1024px, and none occurs on desktop.

title: SAVED_TEXT ↔ form_copy.js_saved_indicator cross-file sync is comment-guarded only; JS-side copy sits outside the em-dash/banned-vocab test enumeration
evidence:
server/priv/static/reference_form.js:26-27:
  // Keep in sync: form_copy.js_saved_indicator.
  var SAVED_TEXT = "Saved";

server/src/reference_checks/form_copy.gleam:340:
pub const js_saved_indicator = "Saved"

server/test/reference_checks/form_copy_test.gleam:147 (inside all_strings()):
    form_copy.js_saved_indicator,
detail: No test reads reference_form.js, so SAVED_TEXT can drift from js_saved_indicator or gain an em-dash/banned word without failure; the em-dash/vocab suite enumerates Gleam constants only, contrary to spec T3.2's 'JS strings' requirement.
recommended_fix: Pin SAVED_TEXT in reference_form.test.js (assert equals the Gleam constant's value) and extend the em-dash/banned-vocab scan to the JS file's user-facing strings.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: Chunk-1 testable behaviour coverage ≈27% (3 of ~11 JS behaviour groups; DOM wiring 0%) — below the 80% gate. No P0 gap (no-JS PRG is server-tested in other chunks), but overall <80% forces FAIL per the gate thresholds.
recommended_fix: Add fake-DOM wiring tests for initBrowser (PUT success, 409/404 reload, both fallbacks, stepping, indicator), pin JS copy, and drop the tautological shouldStep assertions; re-run the gate once coverage ≥80%.
